ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Credential Manager Access via VaultCmd
ruleDefinitions.description: List credentials currently stored in Windows Credential Manager via the native Windows utility vaultcmd.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\VaultCmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "VAULTCMD\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/listcreds\\:.*"))
